description:
Forced into the organization by his father, Liam lives a life committing unwanted crimes. For years, he secretly helps victims escape, but eventually, his actions are discovered. While fleeing to a secluded place to avoid surveillance, he encounters Dogun, a child with lifeless eyes. From that moment, everything in Liam's life begins to change dramatically. 

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/GA3), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/ga3), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000073839), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13218987), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=250738)
